items.headline: AI shak se Asia ke share bazaar dhadaam
items.detail: Kospi 6.2% aur Nikkei 2.8% gira; Nvidia ke CEO Jensen Huang ki wapsi ke baad bhi AI kharch par shak bana raha.
items.exam_angle: AI boom par shak — share bazaar aur arthvyavastha

items.headline: El Nino se Amazon me aag ka khatra
items.detail: October me Amazon me aag ke hotspot 82.6% badhkar lagbhag 24,000 hue; El Nino ke mazboot hone se sookha 2027 tak badh sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: El Nino aur Amazon — paryavaran
items.image_credit: GOES imagery: CSU/CIRA & NOAA, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Russia: videshi bandargah me hamla sambhav
items.detail: Kremlin pravakta Peskov ne Libya me Russian yuddh-pot par Ukraine ke hamle ke baad videshi bandargahon me Ukraine ke jahazon par hamle se inkar nahi kiya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh ka vistaar

items.headline: Trump ka 14 deshon par tariff prastav
items.detail: USTR ne Bharat samet 14 vyaparik saajhedaaron par 25% tak shulk ka prastav diya; China par 20% pehle ke shulk ke upar lagega, lagu January se pehle nahi hoga.
items.exam_angle: America vyapar neeti, Section 301 — UPSC economy

items.headline: CIA-ODNI par cyber hamla, khufiya data leak
items.detail: CIA, ODNI aur NGA ke open-source intelligence system me ghuspaith hui; kuchh unclassified jaankari leak hui, classified data surakshit raha.
items.exam_angle: US intelligence, cyber suraksha, OSINT
items.image_credit: Carol M. Highsmith, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ukraine ne Savasleyka hawai-adda par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ne Russia ke Savasleyka hawai-adde par hamla kiya, jahan Kinzhal missile le jaane wale MiG-31K viman tainat hain.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kinzhal missile

items.headline: Merz: Europe Russia ko uski seema dikhayega
items.detail: Bundestag me Merz ne kaha Russia Baltic se Black Sea tak badh raha hai, isliye 2027 ka defence budget €139.4 billion rakha gaya hai.
items.exam_angle: Germany defence budget, NATO kharch

items.headline: Hormuz me 2 tanker mine se jale
items.detail: Hormuz jaldamroomadhya me mine se do tel tanker phatkar jal gaye; Iran ne nigrani sakht kar di aur kaha jahaz samanvay karke guzrein, varna khatra hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jaldamroomadhya, tel vyapar, Iran-America tanav — UPSC IR

items.headline: Samara ki 2 refinery par drone hamla
items.detail: Raat ke drone hamle me Rosneft ki Syzran aur Kuibyshev refinery me aag lag gayi; governor ne 145 drone giraye jaane aur 1 vyakti ki maut ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump: Ukraine shanti ki koi deadline nahi
items.detail: Trump ne New York Post ko kaha Ukraine-Russia shanti samjhote ke liye unhone koi samay-seema nahi tay ki; Zelensky ke January tak samjhote wale daave par hanse aur kaha dono pakshon ki marzi se hi shanti hogi.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia shanti vaarta, America ki bhoomika — UPSC IR

items.headline: Australia: Big Tech par sakht online kanoon
items.detail: Australia ne Digital Duty of Care kanoon pass kiya; harmful content na hatane par company par global revenue ka 5% tak jurmana lag sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: Digital governance, Big Tech niyaman

items.headline: Raat ke hamlo se Ukraine me bijli gayi
items.detail: Russia ke raat bhar ke hamlo ke baad Ukraine ke paanch kshetron me bijli chali gayi aur Zaporizhzhia parmanu sanyantra ki bahari bijli 2026 me 17vi baar band hui; Kyiv aur Kharkiv me log mare aur ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas adhikari, parivar ke 4 mare
items.detail: Al-Shati camp me Israeli hamle me Hamas ke uttar Gaza suraksha pramukh Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, unki patni aur do betiyan mare gaye, 12 ghayal.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Palestine sangharsh, Gaza yuddh-viram

items.headline: Saudi ne Hodeida bandargah par hamla kiya
items.detail: Saudi-led gathbandhan ne Houthi ke kabze wale Hodeida port par hamla kiya aur Saada-Amran me lakshya dhwast kiye; Houthi ne Saudi bandargahon par badle ki dhamki di.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Saudi-Houthi, Bab el-Mandeb — UPSC IR

items.headline: Odesa hamle me 2 mare, ladka bhi
items.detail: Russia ke hamle me Odesa me ek 17 saal ke ladke samet 2 log mare gaye, 3 ghayal; Kyiv me drone ke malbe se building me aag lagi, 2 ghayal.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza me doosra Hamas adhikari mara gaya
items.detail: Budhvaar subah Gaza City me Israeli hamle me Hamas ke suraksha adhikari Mohammad Abuelouf, unki patni aur 2 bachche mare gaye; 24 ghante me doosre bade Hamas adhikari ki maut hai.
items.exam_angle: Gaza sangharsh, yuddh-viram — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cartagena supermarket me bandhak sankat
items.detail: Colombia ki suraksha balon ne Cartagena ke Exito supermarket par hamla karke 17 ghante ki bandhak sthiti khatm ki; sabhi 20 bandhak surakshit bacha liye gaye, ek hamlaavar mara gaya.

items.headline: Saudi ne Ras Tanura par 7 drone giraye
items.detail: Houthi hamle ke jawab me Saudi air defence ne Ras Tanura par 4 aur Eastern Province me 3 drone mare, koi ghayal nahi.
items.exam_angle: Yemen sangharsh, Ras Tanura tel refinery

items.headline: Balleny Islands me 5.9 ka bhookamp
items.detail: Dakshin Mahasagar ke Balleny Islands kshetra me 5.9 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya, kendra 10 km gehrai me tha; door-daraaz samudri ilaka hone se koi nuksan ya sunami chetavni nahi.
items.exam_angle: Bhookamp, Ring of Fire, plate tectonics — UPSC bhugol

items.headline: Bangladesh me garment vetan 36% badha
items.detail: Vetan board ne nyuntam vetan 12,500 se badhakar 17,000 taka kiya; mazdoor 30,000 taka mang rahe the, 1 December se lagu hoga.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh garment udyog, shramik vetan — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi Aden ke 60 km paas pahunche
items.detail: Houthi ladake Yemen ki asthayi rajdhani Aden se lagbhag 60 km door pahunch gaye; sarkari sena ne raksha rekha banayi aur kaha Aden surakshit rahega.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih-yuddh, Bab el-Mandeb — UPSC IR

items.headline: Putin ne badle ki dhamki di
items.detail: Putin ne kaha Ukraine ne Trump ki appeal ke bawjood refineries par hamle jaari rakhe; badla tay hai, aur hamlo se refinery processing 45% ghata hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Microsoft ne 'Code Red' ghoshit kiya
items.detail: 12-13 November ko 24 ghante ke outage ke baad Microsoft ne 'Code Red' abhiyan shuru kiya; Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams aur Copilot thap hue the, ab bhavishya me ek ghante me global recovery ka lakshya hai.
items.exam_angle: Digital buniyadi dhancha, Microsoft 365 outage — UPSC vigyan-tech

items.headline: Huawei 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi
items.detail: America ki jury ne Huawei ko bank fraud aur trade secret chori ki sajish samet 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi paya; racketeering ke aarop se bari kiya gaya.
items.exam_angle: America-China, Iran pratibandh, trade secret
